_readme: Gold query set for e-Passport retrieval eval, following the BDRIS/e-Return/NID pattern. Hybrid strictness: expected_id set means the exact record must appear in top-K (used heavily here since e-Passport's fee tables are page-count/validity/delivery-tier specific — the wrong fee record gives a wrong BDT/USD amount, which is a serious factual error, not a stylistic miss); expected_id=null means category-level. min_similarity is a soft floor — WARN not FAIL. Includes a probe specifically targeting the one record already flagged source_url_unverified (dhaka-cantonment-jurisdiction) to see whether it's even retrievable, plus a genuine out-of-scope probe. Built from the full epassport corpus (62 records) pasted directly into the session.

queries.query: How much does a 48 page e-passport with 5 years validity cost inside Bangladesh, regular delivery?
queries.note: the four inside-Bangladesh fee tables (48/64pg × 5/10yr) were consolidated into one record, epassport-fees-inside-bd-all, holding every page/validity/delivery amount — so any inside-Bangladesh passport fee query should retrieve it

queries.note: targets the ONE record in the whole corpus already flagged source_url_unverified — checks whether it's even retrievable at all, separate from whether its source is confirmed. A miss here would mean an unverified-source record is also poorly indexed, compounding two problems into one

queries.note: originally targeted a rule buried inside the dense epassport-instructions-submission-office record and failed for exactly that reason (chunk-granularity dilution); that record was split into 6 focused records and this expected_id was updated to point at the new epassport-instructions-diplomatic-passport record

queries.query: who determines which passport office is responsible for my application?
কতগুলো পাসপোর্ট অফিস এখন সক্রিয়ভাবে ই-পাসপোর্ট সেবা দিচ্ছে?
queries.note: category-agnostic observational probe — two records could plausibly answer this: the functional-offices notice list (72 offices) and the five-step-overview record which cites 'Step 1' pointing to that same list. Observing which one (or both) surfaces informs whether the two are meaningfully distinguishable to the retriever

queries.query: আজকে বিকেলে কোথায় ভালো বিরিয়ানি পাওয়া যাবে?
queries.note: OUT-OF-SCOPE probe — restaurant recommendations, zero conceptual/vocabulary overlap with passport content. Should find nothing strong.

queries.query: what documents do I need for a new passport
queries.note: gap guard: this query previously surfaced the 'collection' record (faq-272, about collecting a FINISHED passport). faqs/3 is the exact-title enrolment-documents FAQ and should now win. If it is legitimately outranked by the also-correct notices checklists (notices/34 documents-carried-enrolment or notices/160 checklist, both category 'notices'), relax expected_id to null and keep expected_category.
